verdict.rationale: The evidence describes GoDaddy exposing its APIs to external AI agents via an MCP server and a CLI agent-skill (i.e., third-party assistants can call GoDaddy), but there is no evidence of a built-in AI assistant embedded inside a GoDaddy product/dashboard that a user can delegate tasks to. These are inverse capabilities — enabling outside agents to use GoDaddy, not GoDaddy shipping its own assistant.
